name: @red-cup-engineering/claim-language-rendering-service
description: Renders one news claim through a target language fiber (panini, the composing app over the house language fibers) into a typed translation receipt (source, validation scope, loss profile), per the metroplat translation law (design note §5.3/§6.5/AD-39). Moved out of the substrate's news-content section, since composing panini's fiber engine is an applications-tier concern, not a data form.

scripts.check: node --check src/render-claim-in-language.mjs && node --check src/claim-store.mjs && node --check src/fiber-registry.mjs && node --check scripts/render-claim-in-language.mjs
